export-pdf-page-dimensions-table-count-c.description: The example opens a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page to obtain its width, height, and the number of Table objects, and writes these details to a CSV file.

count-tables-per-pdf-page__v2.title: Count Tables per PDF Page
count-tables-per-pdf-page__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through each page, using TableAbsorber to detect tables, and reporting the number of tables found on each page.

export-empty-pdf-form-fields-to-text.title: Export Empty PDF Form Fields to Text File
export-empty-pdf-form-fields-to-text.description: The example opens a PDF, checks its form fields, and writes the names of fields that have no value (null or empty) to a text file for review.

export-pdf-numeric-fields-to-csv.title: Export PDF Form Fields Containing Numbers to CSV
export-pdf-numeric-fields-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF, scans all form fields and writes those whose values contain at least one digit to a CSV file.

extract-submit-button-urls-from-pdf-form.title: Extract Submit Button URLs from PDF Form
extract-submit-button-urls-from-pdf-form.description: The example opens a PDF document, checks for form fields, and lists the URLs associated with submit‑button actions in the form.

extract-pdf-form-fields-to-json.title: Extract PDF Form Fields and Save to JSON
extract-pdf-form-fields-to-json.description: Demonstrates how to define a rectangle that covers an entire PDF page, iterate through all form fields, collect their details, and serialize the information to a formatted JSON file.

extract-images-from-pdf__v5.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as PNG
extract-images-from-pdf__v5.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, use ImagePlacementAbsorber to collect embedded images, and save each XImage to a PNG file.

count-pdf-operator-occurrences.title: Count PDF Operator Occurrences and Export Summary
count-pdf-operator-occurrences.description: Opens a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page's low‑level operators, counts the occurrences of each operator type, and writes the summary to a text file.

convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-png.title: Convert PDF Pages to High-Resolution PNG Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-png.description: Demonstrates rendering each page of a PDF as a high‑resolution PNG bitmap using Aspose.Pdf's PngDevice and saving the images to disk.

extract-pdf-tables-to-json__v2.title: Extract Tables from PDF to JSON
extract-pdf-tables-to-json__v2.description: The example loads a PDF file, uses Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to extract tables from all pages, and writes the table data as a nested JSON array of rows and cells.

extract-tables-to-plain-text-report.title: Extract Tables from PDF to Plain Text Report
extract-tables-to-plain-text-report.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to locate tables in a PDF, iterate through rows and cells, and write each row's contents with its page number to a plain‑text file.

extract-pdf-tables-to-csv-report.title: Extract PDF Tables to CSV Report
extract-pdf-tables-to-csv-report.description: Loads a PDF, uses Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to locate tables on each page, counts the cells in each table, and writes a CSV file with page number, table index, and cell count.

save-table-borders-even-pages-png.title: Save Table Borders from Even PDF Pages as PNG
save-table-borders-even-pages-png.description: Loads a PDF, iterates over even‑numbered pages, and renders each page (including table borders) to a high‑resolution PNG file using Aspose.Pdf devices.

extract-table-borders-odd-pages.title: Extract Table Borders from Odd Pages as PNG
extract-table-borders-odd-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, render only odd‑numbered pages to PNG images using PngDevice, and save the resulting files containing table borders.

delete-images-extract-text-pdf.title: Delete Specific Images from a PDF Page and Extract Text
delete-images-extract-text-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, removes images at indexes 2 and 4 from page 7, extracts all document text, and saves it to a .txt file.

extract-pdf-text-to-markdown.title: Extract PDF Text to Markdown
extract-pdf-text-to-markdown.description: Loads a PDF file, extracts all its text using Aspose.Pdf's TextAbsorber, and saves the extracted content as a markdown (.md) file.

extract-images-from-pdf__v6.title: Extract Images from PDF with Page and Index Prefix
extract-images-from-pdf__v6.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page, extracts embedded images, and saves them to a folder using filenames prefixed by page number and image index.

count-extracted-images-from-pdf.title: Count Extracted Images from PDF and Write to Text File
count-extracted-images-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page to count embedded images, and writes the total count to a text file.

extract-pdf-text-byte-length.title: Extract PDF Text and Get Byte Length
extract-pdf-text-byte-length.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract all text using TextAbsorber, write it to a MemoryStream, and record the stream's byte length to an output file.

extract-images-from-pdf__v7.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as PNG
extract-images-from-pdf__v7.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page's image resources, and saves each image as a PNG file with a sequential filename pattern.

extract-text-from-pdf-to-txt__v5.title: Extract Text from PDF and Save to File
extract-text-from-pdf-to-txt__v5.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracting its plain text using a TextAbsorber, and writing the result to an Output.txt file.

extract-images-from-pdf-with-page-number.title: Extract Images from PDF with Page Numbers
extract-images-from-pdf-with-page-number.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, extracts embedded images, and saves them as PNG files whose names include the page number and image index.

extract-images-from-pdf__v8.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save to Folder
extract-images-from-pdf__v8.description: Loads a PDF file, iterates through each page's image resources, and saves each image as a PNG file in a designated output folder.

extract-full-text-from-pdf.title: Extract Full Text from PDF and Save to File
extract-full-text-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracting all its text using a TextAbsorber, and writing the extracted content to a plain‑text file.

extract-images-from-pdf__v9.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save with Order Number
extract-images-from-pdf__v9.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page's image resources, and saves each image to disk with a filename that reflects its extraction order.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v18.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v18.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates over all form fields, captures each field's name, type, and value, and writes the collected information to a JSON file.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v19.title: Export PDF Form Fields to Indented JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v19.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through all form fields, and writes their name, type, and value to a formatted JSON file with indentation enabled.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v20.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON Including Password Values
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v20.description: Shows how to load a PDF (optionally with a user password), enable the ExportPasswordValue flag, and export all AcroForm fields to a JSON file.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v21.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v21.description: Loads a PDF document, extracts all form field values (handling different field types), and writes the data to a JSON file using a FileStream.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v22.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON via MemoryStream
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v22.description: Loads a PDF document, extracts all interactive form fields, writes the JSON representation to a MemoryStream, and saves it to disk.

export-pdf-widget-annotation-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Widget Annotation to JSON
export-pdf-widget-annotation-to-json.description: Loads a PDF, retrieves a specific form widget annotation by name, extracts its rectangle and value, and writes the information to a JSON file.

export-widget-annotation-to-json.title: Export Widget Annotation Field to JSON from PDF
export-widget-annotation-to-json.description: Loads a PDF via FileStream, locates a specific WidgetAnnotation form field by name, and writes its key properties (name, rectangle, value) to a JSON file.

export-widgetannotation-to-json.title: Export WidgetAnnotation to JSON using MemoryStream
export-widgetannotation-to-json.description: Loads a PDF, locates a specific WidgetAnnotation by name, extracts its properties and page number, and serializes the information to JSON via a MemoryStream.

export-pdf-form-field-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Field Value to JSON
export-pdf-form-field-to-json.description: Loads a PDF via FileStream, reads a specific form field value, and writes it as a formatted JSON file using another FileStream.

export-pdf-form-field-to-json__v2.title: Export PDF Form Field Value to JSON via MemoryStream
export-pdf-form-field-to-json__v2.description: Loads a PDF, reads a specific form field value, and serializes it to JSON using a MemoryStream.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v23.title: Export PDF Form Fields to Indented JSON with Password Values
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v23.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, configure ExportFieldsToJsonOptions to pretty‑print and include password field values, and export all form fields to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-compact-json.title: Export PDF Form Fields to Compact JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-compact-json.description: Demonstrates how to export all form fields from a PDF document to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf with compact (non‑indented) formatting.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v24.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON without Password Values
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v24.description: Shows how to export all form fields from a PDF document to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf while omitting password field values by disabling ExportPasswordValue.

export-specific-pdf-form-field-to-indent.title: Export Specific PDF Form Field to Indented JSON
export-specific-pdf-form-field-to-indent.description: The example loads a PDF document, exports all form fields to JSON, filters for a single field (CustomerName), and writes the result as indented JSON using System.Text.Json.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-indented-json.title: Export PDF Form Fields to Indented JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-indented-json.description: Shows how to extract all form fields from a PDF document and write them to a pretty‑printed JSON file using Aspose.Pdf's ExportToJson method with indented output.

export-pdf-form-password-values-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Password Values to JSON
export-pdf-form-password-values-to-json.description: Demonstrates how to export only password field values from a PDF form to a JSON file using ExportFieldsToJsonOptions with ExportPasswordValue enabled.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v25.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v25.description: Demonstrates how to export all form fields from a PDF document to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf with default options.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v26.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON via MemoryStream
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v26.description: Shows how to read all form fields from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, serialize the field names and values to JSON, write the JSON into a MemoryStream, and save the stream directly as a .json file.
